analysis: Reporting addendum to frozen v1.0; actual observation duration only
authorization: User requests existing-summary search, then necessary description from the unchanged v1.0 cohort and existing time fields if absent
population: Same deterministic v1.0 selection; 5230 unique patients and 5577 eligible admissions before patient selection
end: Earliest of verified continuous ICU episode_stop, dischtime, deathtime if present, and t0+24h
duration_hours: maximal permitted follow-up duration from t0 to the above end; not stopped at first repeat; no additional exclusions or imputation
descriptions: duration median and linear Q1/Q3 in hours
duration equal to 24h n and percent
boundary: Duration exactly 24h belongs to the 24h duration category even if clinical end ties the cap. Original repeat-at-end tie rules remain unchanged.
verification: Finite positive durations, all N preserved
All source SHA256 and size/mtime unchanged
limits: Reporting-completeness addendum performed after the original analysis; no claim this summary was prospectively prespecified; no new clinical variables, outcomes, sensitivities, CI estimates, tests or models
privacy: Patient rows and identifiers remain in RAM; exports aggregate only. Never overwrite existing v1.0 artifacts.
